I've applied the fix. The key change: the redundant-lookup shortcut now only applies when `prev_field.remote_field.parent_link` is True (i.e., concrete inheritance via a parent link), rather than for any relation whose target fields happen to include the next part. This prevents a ForeignKey-as-primary-key (OneToOneField with primary_key=True) from being mistaken for concrete inheritance.

Let me verify with the public regression tests.
